newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Trustpower says off to strong start.
newsitem.headline: Trustpower says off to strong start.

text.p: New Zealand electricity company Trustpower Ltd said on Wednesday it had started the year strongly, with net profit exceeding NZ$6 million for the four months to July 31.
Trustpower recorded a net profit of $11.1 million for the year to March 31.

Chairman Avon Carpenter said the first four months were over 90 percent ahead of the same period last year, but the figures were not comparable because Taupo Electricity was not part of the group at that time and Rotorua Electricity was not fully-owned.

"The four months result does, however, represent a 50 percent increase on our budgeted figure, and the effect of those acquisitions is now being reflected in the profit results," he told the annual meeting.

He noted the company's three generation schemes had all bnefited from unusually good water flows. "Apart from the contribution from generation, gains in energy trading on the spot market and increases in the budgeted sales have been responsible for the excellent result," he said.
